text:
When to Dynamax...?\c
It might be a good idea to think ahead about
which Pokémon is able to withstand Nessa’s
Max Moves.
I like your team—it’s very charming!\c\nLet’s both do our best to complete the\nGym Challenge, OK?

Why do we have to figure out a puzzle just
to face the Gym Leader...?\c
Maybe it’s to tell us Trainers that we need to
have some mental flexibility?
I’m glad I became your fan,\nChallenger [VAR 0100(0000)]!
Nessa is strong, and that’s\nwhat’s beautiful!
Hey! It’s the best Champion\nof them all!
